headline: Every respondent is employed, a rare 100.0 %, with full-time work at 85.0 %.
how_to_read: Flows run from all respondents (left) to employed or not employed (middle) and then to detailed situation (right); width is the share of respondents. The hatched "Hidden" flow sits within the employed branch and covers details held back because fewer than 3 people fall into them.
key_findings: Employment is 100.0 % and the not-employed branch is empty.
Full-time work accounts for 85.0 %; part-time, self-employed and other employment are hidden (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Employment is 8.7 pp above Asia (91.3 %) and 7.4 pp above all schools (92.6 %). Full-time work leads Asia (74.6 %) by 10.4 pp and all schools (74.9 %) by 10.1 pp.
caveats: With n = 20, each person moves the percentages by several points, so a single non-employed graduate would visibly change the picture.
